name: plotcon
summary: EMBOSS 6.6.0 plotcon: the similarity of a multiple alignment along its length (the data of the plot, -graph data).
short: EMBOSS plotcon: plots the similarity of a multiple alignment along its length (matrix score of every pair of residues, windowed); equals plotcon 6.6.0 on 400 + 1 500 runs.
description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 plotcon: the similarity of a multiple alignment along its length: per column the sum over all pairs of sequences of the matrix score (EBLOSUM62 for protein, EDNAFULL for nucleic acids), averaged over a window of winsize columns; the result is the data file of -graph data. See the tool description in the code for the parameters.

text: The data file plotcon1.dat of -graph data (the title, the extent and x / y of every column)
files: The other files the program wrote, by name
messages: What the program wrote to its error stream

errors: The program died: the messages of the library (a matrix it cannot read, a value it refuses, an input no reader reads)
An input on which the reference program has no defined result is refused with the reason

example.title: Three proteins, window of 4 columns
example.prompt: Plot the similarity of this alignment.
example.note: The first window (columns 1-4) has the pair scores 2 x 15 + 2 x 15 + 2 x 7 + 2 x 12 = 98 (BLOSUM62: M/M 5, K/K 5, T/T 5, T/S 1, A/A 4) divided by 3 x 2 x 4 x 4 = 96: 1.020833 at point 3.

name: alignment_summary_info
summary: Bio.Align.AlignInfo.SummaryInfo of Biopython 1.79: dumb / gap consensus, replacement dictionary, position-specific score matrix, information content (ic_vector), get_column, print_info_content.
short: Bio.Align.AlignInfo.SummaryInfo of Biopython 1.79: consensus, replacement dictionary, PSSM, information content; equal to the Biopython test values.
description: One member of Bio.Align.AlignInfo.SummaryInfo of Biopython 1.79 on an alignment of records: dumb_consensus, gap_consensus, replacement_dictionary, pos_specific_score_matrix, information_content, ic_vector, print_info_content, get_column. See the tool description in the code for the parameters.

resultJson: The value as JSON: a consensus string, [[a, b, weight], ...], {rows, text} of the PSSM, {value, ic_vector}, a column
text: The printed table of the PSSM or print_info_content

errors: Unknown operation, or an alignment that is not a JSON array of records
information_content without an expected-frequency table (Biopython's TypeError), a range outside the first row, a negative pseudo count, a letter missing in the table
A residue that is not among the counted letters (PSSM)

example.title: The consensus of three proteins
example.prompt: Give the dumb consensus of this protein alignment.
example.note: The value of Tests/test_AlignInfo.py of Biopython 1.79.

name: msa_conservation
summary: The per-column conservation scores of Capra and Singh (2007): Jensen-Shannon divergence, Shannon / property entropy, relative entropy, sum of pairs, with gap penalty, sequence weights and a window.
short: Capra and Singh (2007) column conservation: Jensen-Shannon divergence (default), Shannon entropy, property / relative entropy, sum of pairs; window, gap penalty, Henikoff weights.
description: The conservation score of every column of a protein alignment as in the program of Capra and Singh (2007): js_divergence, shannon_entropy, property_entropy, relative_entropy or sum_of_pairs, with the gap penalty, the sequence weights of Henikoff and Henikoff and a smoothing window. See the tool description in the code for the parameters.

sequenceWeights: The weights of the rows (empty without sequenceWeights)

errors: At least one sequence is required
Rows of unequal length, a letter outside the 20 amino acids in sum_of_pairs or the weights

example.title: Five conserved columns
example.prompt: Score the conservation of these columns.
example.note: The first column is five A (score 0.79906: the divergence of a conserved alanine column from the BLOSUM62 background, A 7.8 %).
